Let $C={C}_{1}\cup {C}_{2}\cup {C}_{3}$ be a piecewise smooth path in the $xy$-plane, and let $-C$ be the curve consisting of the same points as $C$ but with the opposite orientation. 

For line integrals with respect to $x,$ we have the following properties:

- ${\int }_{-C}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x=-{\int }_{C}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x$

- ${\int }_{C}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x={\int }_{{C}_{1}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{{C}_{2}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{{C}_{3}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x$

In our case, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{C}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x & ={\int }_{{C}_{1}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{{C}_{2}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{{C}_{3}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x \\ -{\int }_{-C}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x & =2-{\int }_{-{C}_{2}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x+{\int }_{{C}_{3}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x \\ -21 & =2-(-11)+{\int }_{{C}_{3}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x \\ -21 & =13+{\int }_{{C}_{3}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x \\ -34 & ={\int }_{{C}_{3}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
{\int }_{{C}_{3}}f(x,y)\,\text{d}x=-34.
$$
